categories.main_business_segments: Zhiyang Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on AI-driven digital and intelligent transformation solutions primarily for the power, water conservancy, rail transit, and new energy sectors. Its main products include AI platforms, big data and digital twin platforms, industrial large models, AI agents, AI terminals, and embodied intelligent drone technology. The company offers AI solutions for power transmission, substation, distribution, water conservancy digital twin systems, rail transit safety, and photovoltaic inspection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI algorithms, big data analytics, IoT, digital twin technology, and embodied intelligence. It has developed six foundational technology platforms integrating algorithms, software, and hardware for multi-modal data perception, cloud-edge collaboration, and intelligent decision-making. Production follows a project order-based model with in-house design and assembly of core intelligent terminals and communication modules, combined with supplier-provided components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include various levels of power grid companies and their subsidiaries, water conservancy authorities, rail transit operators, and new energy enterprises. The company serves major markets across China, providing AI solutions for power grid digitalization, water resource management, rail safety, and renewable energy inspection. Its products have been deployed in significant national projects and international events.
categories.geographic_coverage: Zhiyang Innovation operates primarily across China with coverage in all provincial-level regions except Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Major regional markets include East China, North China, Northwest China, Central China, Northeast China, Southwest China, and South China. The company has R&D centers in Jinan, Zibo, Beijing, and Guangzhou.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI technology supply chain, focusing on AI algorithm development, software platforms, intelligent hardware production, and system integration. It designs and assembles core intelligent terminal devices and modules, sourcing components from suppliers, and delivers integrated AI solutions and services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Zhiyang Innovation prioritizes continuous R&D investment in AI algorithms, industrial large models, embodied intelligence, and intelligent hardware. It emphasizes cross-disciplinary innovation integrating AI, IoT, big data, digital twin, and robotics. The company actively collaborates with academic institutions and focuses on expanding AI applications across multiple industries while enhancing its six foundational technology platforms and ecosystem partnerships, including integration with the OpenHarmony ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of AI solutions, software, and intelligent hardware products. Sales are mainly secured via bidding, competitive negotiation, and business negotiation channels. Revenue recognition is based on customer acceptance of delivered products and services, with a project order-based production and delivery model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhiyang Innovation is positioned as a leading domestic AI technology provider in the power sector with expanding presence in water conservancy, rail transit, and new energy industries. It holds a strong market share in AI-enabled power grid inspection and monitoring, recognized for its technological innovation and comprehensive AI platforms. The company benefits from early mover advantages and government support but faces competition from other AI and digital transformation firms in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 970.7 million, a 21.62% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.3 million, up 23.6%. Total assets reached RMB 1.52 billion, growing 8.06%. R&D investment accounted for 11.46% of revenue. The company maintains steady growth with expanding market penetration and increasing profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhiyang Innovation emphasizes its integrated AI technology stack combining algorithms, software, and hardware to deliver end-to-end intelligent solutions tailored to industry-specific scenarios. Its unique value lies in deep industry knowledge, advanced AI platforms including large industrial models and embodied intelligence drones, and strong ecosystem collaborations. The company offers high-precision, real-time monitoring and predictive analytics that enhance operational efficiency, safety, and digital transformation for critical infrastructure sectors.
